outcome: Cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (CS-IFC)
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who underwent ultrasound at 35+0-41+0 weeks and gave birth within 1 month of examination (n=5,193)
finding: The accuracy of CPR in predicting CS-IFC decreased as the interval to delivery increased, with the best prediction achieved prior to labor when combined with EFWc and TLO.
